run_bm_chamfer: run the bm_chamfer benchmark function to measure chamfer distance performance on cpu and cuda devices
benchmark_chamfer_naive: benchmark the naive chamfer distance implementation across various batch sizes and device configurations
benchmark_chamfer_cuda: benchmark the optimized chamfer distance implementation on cuda with varying point cloud sizes

test_chamfer_benchmark: test the chamfer distance benchmark using fvcore benchmark with warmup iterations
